fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-06-11, a document allegedly prepared using forged details of the complainant was used to seek a payment of Rs. 50,000. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-06-08 at about 16:20. The complaint mentions Anand Palanisamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000093, in connection with the events. A second person, Anand Muthu (9000000280), was also mentioned as possibly present. The account reference SYN-ACC-100029 was noted in connection with the payment. Kavitha Selvam (9000000099) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned physical documents.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged document, mobile number, market road, documents, suspect, receiving account, witness
